taxonomic_note: Accepted species. Texas native context is secure, but only Travis is currently locked inside the project target zone.
look_here_first: Start with the leaves: smooth to glabrous sessile leaves with rounded bases visibly clasp the stem. Yellow rays often show a reddish-brown basal eye around the raised dark cone.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is exact. Williamson was present in the older review but is outside the project target-county list. Hays TxDOT seed use is deliberate planting and is not native evidence.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: sessile leaves with rounded clasping bases
yellow rays often with dark basal eye
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The clasping leaf bases are the fastest separator; do not use yellow ray color alone.

comparisons.key_distinctions: R. amplexicaulis is smoother and has conspicuously clasping sessile leaves; R. hirta is generally hairier and lacks the same clasping leaf-base look.
